title: SC-02 independent exported-asset visual review, initial pass

reviewer.method: Read user objective and bounded evidence packet; inspect each of 30 individual exported-GLB thumbnails before implementation source; no implementation source inspected.

objective: A production-quality premium real-time spatial asset library; primitive stand-ins and counts alone do not satisfy the brief.

sourceIdentity.limitation: This review binds the preserved evidence hashes and snapshot, not a frozen committed product candidate.

overall.rationale: All 30 supplied thumbnails are visibly blank and byte-identical. No model quality judgment is possible. This is a confirmed evidence/preview blocker, not proof that the underlying GLB geometry itself is low quality.

findings.observation: All 30 individual PNGs contain the same uniform dark background with no visible geometry.
findings.effect: The library preview and independent premium-quality evidence are unusable for every catalog asset.
findings.requiredRepair: Regenerate visible, consistently lit and framed exported-GLB thumbnails; add representative close and alternate views; re-review all affected assets.

findings.observation: Every metrics entry records null for all dimensions and minimum coordinates.
findings.effect: The render pipeline has not provided usable geometric bounds; reported calls, triangles, and errors=[] cannot establish valid framing, scale, or visible output.
findings.requiredRepair: Repair bounds measurement, require finite bounds and nonblank rendered output, and rerun the asset render pipeline.

capabilityStatus.catalogCoverage: DECLARED: 30 named entries in six requested families; distinctness is not visually established
capabilityStatus.metadata: DECLARED: each entry has dimensions, support, collision, pivot, normal and PBR labels; geometric correctness is unverified
capabilityStatus.materialResponse: UNVERIFIED: no rendered surface is visible
capabilityStatus.provenance: MANIFEST_DECLARED_ONLY: AI_ASSISTED original geometry, proprietary license, owner authorization required, not published; license document and source originality not audited here
capabilityStatus.exportedPipeline: REPORTED: all entries have load/render counters and no reported loader errors; visible success is contradicted by blank output
capabilityStatus.performance: OBSERVATION_ONLY: software WebGL pipeline loadAndRenderMs is about 18.8 to 104 ms per asset; no editor scene frame-rate, memory cleanup, target-device budget, cold/warm method or repeatability proof
capabilityStatus.productBrowserExperience: NOT_REVIEWED: separate browser captures are required
capabilityStatus.pivotsScalePlacementCollision: NOT_REVIEWED: metadata and null bounds do not prove behavior
capabilityStatus.interactiveAffordances: NOT_REVIEWED: static blank previews cannot prove hinge, slide or cloth behavior

limitations: Only the supplied asset pipeline thumbnails, manifest and metrics were reviewed; no application screenshots or recordings were supplied in this pass.
One blank view per asset cannot establish back-face correctness, texture quality, edge detail, material response under different light, support/collision correctness, or animation quality.
Do not substitute successful tests, file counts, triangle counts, catalog prose, or PBR metadata labels for visual quality acceptance.
The supplied review packet does not establish final SC-02 production completeness, product journey acceptance, real-device behavior, or owner acceptance.
The preserved initial snapshot remains evidence of this pass even if original thumbnail paths are later regenerated.
